cards.front: What should you know about lattice enthalpy?
cards.back: Enthalpy change when one mole of solid ionic lattice forms from gaseous ions under standard conditions (exothermic).

cards.front: What should you know about gibbs free energy?
cards.back: ΔG = ΔH - TΔS. A reaction is thermodynamically feasible when ΔG ≤ 0.
